en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style image of a large, ornate Victorian Gothic/Second Empire style public building with a tall clock tower and steeply pitched roofs. The structure has many windows, elaborate stone detailing, and a grand stairway leading to arched entrances. Mature trees and a picket fence line the street in the foreground, with smaller houses and other buildings visible in the background. The borders of the image show some damage and handwritten numbers along the right edge.
